title: Akiyama Mizuki — Wanted To Say It In Person〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: Wanted To Say It In Person（4★）

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School - Class 2-B

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, finished!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sir, I'm all done!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Hm? You finished quicker than usual today.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I've really gotta be somewhere today, so I'd appreciate it if you could check this ASAP.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Alright, I get it.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Okay, this does look like everything.
You're free to go.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Woohoo♪

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Honestly, if you're able to focus like this, then you really should just show up for classes like normal...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No waaay. Besides I totally prefer the worksheets you make way more.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Then, I'll make you a hundred next time.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I don't mind since you have to make and grade them♪

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Grr... You...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! Anyway, see you later!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, off to Miya Girls.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm glad we get to leave early today since they're probably still having classes...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyway, I've gotta hurry!
se_run_women_002_1
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - School Gate

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Phew... I think I made it in time...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, I need to send Mafuyu a message.
Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... I probably shouldn't say too much and just keep things simple by letting her know that I'm waiting outside the school gate.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay, that should do it...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I have no idea if I'll be able to see her since we didn't plan to meet in advance...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But I feel that I need to tell her this...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (So that she can find a way to move forward.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh...
Does this mean their last homeroom's over?

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: My arms feel totally overloaded after they made us do all those extra workouts during our morning practice. Actually, they're already starting to feel sore...

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: Wait, you're just bragging about how young and fit you are.

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line:
No, I'm telling the truth! Honest!
Oh...

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line:
That surprised me for a second...
Isn't that the uniform for...?

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line:
Kamiyama High, right?
Maybe a friend goes here.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Yeah, seeing someone in a different uniform would be a bit surprising.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I'm going to stand out no matter what, so I'll just fiddle with my phone and pretend like I didn't notice.)

rows.Speaker: Student C
rows.Line: Hey, isn't that show Minori and her group are appearing on airing today?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Oh, that's right!
They're gonna be on “Come Tell Us Your Good News!”)

rows.Speaker: Student D
rows.Line:
I'm so excited.
But it starts at two in the morning, right? I dunno if I can stay awake.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(2:00 a.m.? No problem!
In my book, the night is still young.)

rows.Speaker: Student C
rows.Line: You promised that we'd have a call while we watched, so you gotta stay awake.

rows.Speaker: Student D
rows.Line: Alright, I will. I mean, I would rather see it in real-time than as a recording.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Are they the same year as Minori? Which makes them second-years. What if they used to be in the same class?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Also, it's amazing how much she and the others have been on TV recently...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Everyone around me seems to be working so hard at what they're doing...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But Mafuyu takes priority right now.
Did she see my message...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, it says she had...
Does that mean she's coming to the gate, or...

rows.Speaker: Student E
rows.Line: Did you see the hair ribbon that person by the gate was wearing? It was so cute.

rows.Speaker: Student F
rows.Line: No, I was more focused on their pretty hairdo. What kind of ribbon was it?

rows.Speaker: Student E
rows.Line:
It was dark brown with white stripes.
It was subtle, but still cute.
Oh, there was also a little charm on it!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(She noticed my ribbon? Sharp eyes.
Maybe she likes these kinds of accessories.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Wait, I ended up listening to their whole conversation...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Now I feel bad for eavesdropping. I'll try listening to some music instead...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, I got a message!
Does this mean...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Message
rows.Line: <Okay, I'm heading over now.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yes, Mafuyu replied!
<Great, I'll be waiting♪>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Thank goodness. She's coming.
Now I'm really glad that I was able to knock out all those worksheets.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (All that's left is...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (To tell Mafuyu.)
